Data Science Intern
Corvid Analytics

We build demand forecasting models for logistics companies. This internship is
hands on: you will own a model from data preparation through evaluation.

What you will do
- Prepare and explore large time-series datasets
- Train and evaluate forecasting models
- Document experiments so results can be reproduced
- Present your work to the team at the end of the internship

Minimum requirements
- Enrolled in a Master's or final-year Bachelor's programme in a quantitative field
- At least 1 year of hands-on experience with Python for data work, through
  coursework, research or projects
- Working knowledge of pandas, NumPy and scikit-learn
- Understanding of core statistics: distributions, hypothesis testing, regression
- SQL proficiency

Desirable
- 2+ years of exposure to machine learning through research or projects
- Experience with time-series methods such as ARIMA or Prophet
- Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Experience presenting technical work to non-technical audiences
